from pathlib import Path
import json,re
event="1791199981-791233be95ec"
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
msg=None
for d in ("sent","inflight","outbox"):
    p=base/d/f"{event}.json"
    if p.is_file():
        obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"))
        msg=str(obj.get("message") or "")
        break
if msg is None:
    print("DIRTY_DECISION=EVENT_MISSING",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(2)
m=re.search(r'DIRTY_DETAIL=(\{.*\})\s*$',msg,re.M)
if not m:
    print("DIRTY_DECISION=DETAIL_MISSING",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(2)
d=json.loads(m.group(1))
st=d.get("staged") or {}
wt=d.get("worktree") or {}
diffs=d.get("diffs") or []
out={
 "staged_n":st.get("staged_n"),
 "unstaged_n":st.get("unstaged_n"),
 "represented_n":st.get("represented_n"),
 "staged_different_n":st.get("different_n"),
 "staged_paths":st.get("staged_sample") or [],
 "staged_different":st.get("different_sample") or [],
 "worktree_dirty_n":wt.get("dirty_count"),
 "worktree_equal_n":wt.get("equal_count"),
 "worktree_different_n":wt.get("different_count"),
 "worktree_missing_source_n":wt.get("missing_in_source_count"),
 "worktree_different":wt.get("different") or [],
 "worktree_missing_source":wt.get("missing_in_source") or [],
 "diff_paths":{str(x.get("mode")):x.get("paths") or [] for x in diffs},
 "diff_truncated":{str(x.get("mode")):bool(x.get("truncated")) for x in diffs},
}
print("DIRTY_DECISION="+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0)
